P0 — COMPLETE IVX STABILIZATION TO 10/10

MODE: EXECUTE ONLY
NO NEW FEATURES.
NO NARRATIVE REPORTS.
WORK UNTIL EACH ITEM IS VERIFIED WITH EVIDENCE.

OBJECTIVE

Complete IVX IA as an enterprise-grade autonomous engineering system by closing every remaining gap one by one. Continue working 24/7 until only owner approvals are required.

PHASE 1 — RESTORE AUTONOMOUS ENGINEERING

1. Restore authenticated GitHub owner session.
2. Restore GitHub Actions read/write.
3. Restore Workflow read/write.
4. Restore Pull Request creation.
5. Restore Branch Protection read.
6. Restore Branch Protection write.
7. Restore Render deployment read.
8. Verify owner runtime authentication.

Return PASS/FAIL for each item with evidence.

PHASE 2 — STABILIZE CI

Fix every remaining CI blocker until all required workflows pass.

Required:

• IVX CI
• IVX QA Suite
• IVX E2E Acceptance
• Android Emulator QA
• iOS Simulator QA

Goal:

Three consecutive PASS runs on the same GitHub main SHA.

PHASE 3 — AUTONOMOUS ENGINEERING MODE

After CI is green:

Enable continuous engineering.

The autonomous system must continuously:

• inspect the repository
• detect crashes
• detect memory leaks
• detect dead code
• detect duplicate code
• detect security issues
• detect performance regressions
• detect dependency issues
• detect architecture violations
• detect race conditions
• detect database problems
• detect deployment issues

For every issue:

Diagnose
→ identify root cause
→ generate repair
→ create isolated branch
→ add regression tests
→ run tests
→ open PR
→ wait for approval
→ merge
→ deploy
→ verify production
→ record evidence

Never claim COMPLETE without proof.

PHASE 4 — SELF-HEALING

Implement enterprise self-healing.

If a production error occurs:

Detect within seconds.
Capture logs.
Capture stack trace.
Identify affected module.
Generate repair.
Run regression tests.
Deploy only after CI passes.
Verify production.
Close incident automatically.

If confidence is below required threshold:

Stop.
Request owner approval.

PHASE 5 — CONTINUOUS QUALITY

Run continuously 24/7:

• TypeScript
• Lint
• Unit tests
• Integration tests
• E2E tests
• Security scan
• Dependency audit
• Performance audit
• Memory audit
• Database audit
• API audit
• Render health audit
• GitHub audit

Automatically create a prioritized backlog.

Always repair the highest-priority verified issue first.

PHASE 6 — PRODUCTION VERIFICATION

Every deployment must prove:

GitHub main SHA
=
CI-tested SHA
=
Render deployed SHA
=
/health SHA
=
/version SHA

If any value differs:

Deployment = FAILED.

PHASE 7 — DAILY AUTONOMOUS ENGINEERING

Continue operating 24/7.

Every completed repair must include:

• Job ID
• Trace ID
• Branch
• PR
• Commit SHA
• CI Run ID
• Render Deployment ID
• Production SHA
• Files changed
• Tests added
• PASS/FAIL
• Timestamp

Only stop when:

• all critical gaps are closed;
• all workflows are green;
• production is stable;
• autonomous engineering is fully operational;
• remaining work requires explicit owner approval.

Do not stop after one repair.

Continue through the backlog automatically until all verified engineering gaps are resolved.
